knowledge.purpose: A "back to top" button that appears once the page has scrolled and takes the visitor to the top.
useCases: Under a documentation page's table of contents
At the foot of a long article or a long list
antiPatterns: A short page that never scrolls — it would never show
Navigation to a section — link to its anchor
A floating button over the content on a phone — place it in the page's own column
knowledge.implementation: A <button> with the label prop, else the app word ui.backToTop, and a small up chevron. Hidden (opacity 0, aria-hidden, out of the tab order) until the page has scrolled past showAfter px (default 400); the first frame draws it hidden. A click scrolls to the top, smoothly unless the visitor prefers reduced motion. Its ink is --pw-back-to-top-ink (default the muted text), --pw-back-to-top-hover-ink on hover.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's word ("Scroll to top"). Unset: the app's ui.backToTop. Write it in the app's language.

props.name: showAfter
props.description: Shown once the page has scrolled this many px.

tokens.name: hoverInk
tokens.description: Ink of the link under the pointer.
